items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-05-26
items.q: But he filled in for Ryzenweather's two theater jobs we had. One was in Brooklyn, one was in New York.

ctx.x: Did your piano play just the straight chords?

Play chords and he played bass, played bass and contramelody. We were able to fill in. In other words, he'd have to know the rhythm twice, play the chords, and he played bass too. You see, there was bass hand. And the other one he played, contramelodies, no melody. All contramelodies and harmonies. And that's what he was to play. And I couldn't get to these fellows. All they played bird music up on top of the piano. Bird music. There was no foundation tone and they disrupt the band. Now, along comes Robinson. He…
I'm sorry, I didn't get anything about the trombone player.
